name: todo-webapp
description: Single-page React app where a signed-in user manages their personal task list: create, view, edit, complete, delete, and sort/filter tasks that optionally carry a due date, with overdue tasks visually highlighted. Holds no task data itself — all reads and writes go through todo-api.

dependencies.name: todo-api
dependencies.description: Backend API for creating, listing, editing, completing, and deleting the signed-in user's own tasks, including due dates and sort/filter support.

dependencies.name: thunder-auth
dependencies.description: Thunder-issued OIDC client used for browser sign-in (OIDC + PKCE) so the user's task list is private to them.
